about.title: About Me
about.description: Welcome to my artistic portfolio. I am a passionate artist who loves to express creativity through various mediums.
about.journeyDescription: I have been exploring the world of art for many years, creating pieces that reflect my personal experiences and cultural heritage.
about.techniquesDescription: I work with various techniques including oil painting, watercolor, digital art, and photography.
about.inspirationDescription: My work is inspired by nature, Persian culture, and the beautiful moments of everyday life.
about.paintingDescription: Painting and drawing from my own imagination and from the nature.
about.engravingDescription: Engraving on metal and wood and copper.
about.portraitPhotographyDescription: Capturing the essence of people through intimate and expressive portraits.
about.landscapePhotographyDescription: Exploring the beauty of nature and urban environments through wide-angle perspectives.
about.connectDescription: I'm always interested in new collaborations and opportunities. Whether you're looking for a painter or a photographer for your next project or just want to discuss photography, I'd love to hear from you.

collections.title: Paintings Collections
collections.description: Explore my curated collections of paintings and artworks
collections.noNameDescription: A 19th-century art movement characterized by relatively small, thin, yet visible brush strokes, open composition, emphasis on accurate depiction of light in its changing qualities.
collections.abstractDescription: Abstract paintings are characterized by their lack of representational content, focusing instead on the use of color, shape, and form to create a visual experience.

resume.title: Resume
resume.description: Professional Painter with over 5 years of experience in painting and drawing.
resume.painterDescription: Painting and drawing and sending paintings to galleries and selling them.
resume.instructorDescription: Taught painting fundamentals to beginners and intermediate students. Conducted workshops on composition and lighting.
resume.bachelorDescription: Focused on painting techniques, art history, and visual storytelling.
resume.highSchoolDescription: Intensive program covering advanced painting techniques, art history, and visual storytelling.
